state_reference.standardization: population mean and population SD across the retained v1.31 island population, computed without any species response

generic_network_R2.distance: haversine great-circle kilometers from Appendix 2 centroids
generic_network_R2.k_selection: smallest integer k from 1 through 20 that makes every retained bioregion subgraph connected
generic_network_R2.failure: STOP if any retained bioregion is not connected by k<=20
generic_network_R2.edge_decay_scale: within-bioregion median unique selected edge length
generic_network_R2.generic_neighbor_pressure: sum exp(-edge_distance_km / bioregion_edge_decay_scale) across incident response-independent graph edges

future_species_conditioned_reference.pilot_training_rows: each pilot target block must compute all species-conditioned R3/C features from all other pilot blocks only
future_species_conditioned_reference.confirmatory_rows: all species-conditioned R3/C features use the complete retained pilot source pool and no confirmatory response
